description:
Experience love, loyalty and betrayal in a modern retelling of a classic Korean folktale. Princess Pyeonggang flees the palace, becomes an assassin and falls for Dal On, a peace-loving man. Can they fight for their love amidst lethal battles or will the forces of darkness tear them apart?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Toomics](https://toomics.com/click/intro?cno=7875&pid=webtoonguide), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9572197), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/61754070), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/moonrising_river)

**Official Translations:**
